source: Dow-Jones Industrial Averages as tabled in the 1949 book (W009), Ch. VII 'Record of 3-Day Moves on Averages 1912 to 1949' (printed pp.66-75) and '9-Point Chart Swings or More of the Averages' (pp.75-79). Transcribed from page images, literature-reading-output checkpoint_v7 works/W009/transcriptions/ch07_3day_record.md and ch07_9point_record.md, parsed by scripts/parse-dow-swing-record.py. Kind is the printed A/D where given, else read from the neighbouring entries (tops and bottoms alternate).
fixes: 9-Point 1919 'July 20' 98.46 dated Aug. 20 as the 3-Day record dates it
9-Point 1948 'July 11' read Feb. 11 (the book's Chart 4 labels it 1948 FEB 11)
gaps: 9-Point: none between 1921-08-24 and 1922-10-14 (as printed: no 9-point reaction that year)
Both: the exchange was closed 1914-07-31 to 1914-12-11
